newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Dec 25.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Dec 25.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Cellular phones stolen in Europe are creeping into the UAE market. The GSM service was introduced in the UAE in 1994.
- The price of mobile telephones in the UAE increased by 10 to 12 percent last month.
- Saudi businesses have been invited to invest $12.8 billion in 45 projects in Egypt.
- Bahrain said it would set up a national guard to reinforce security and stability.

- Abu Dhabi issued a law to establish a national agency for tourism and hotels with base capital of 100 million dirhams. According the law, the government of Abu Dhabi is to sell three of its hotels to the agency for a total of 350 million dirhams.

- A Gulf-European ministerial council will meet in Doha on February 17, 1997, to discuss a framework for an agreement to encourage investment and cooperation in the fields of power and customs, the paper quotes sources as saying. The end of 1998 is seen as a final deadline to reach a free trade deal.
